properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
properties.notes: permission has been given for the redevelopment of rugby club and hard standing to provide for its relocation and additionally 14 dwellings. Remainder of site is suitable for redevelopment and possibly some element of conversion.. Most of site covered by outline permission for demolition of existing clubhouse, associated changing rooms and outbuilding. Redevelopment of the site to provide new dwellings (14 no) and new clubhouse and associated parking facilities.
